title: Better Vanilla+
description: This Modpack Aims to enhace the default Minecraft Experience without disturbing the Charm of the Vanilla Game.
body: This modpack is designed to enhance the classic Minecraft experience without straying too far from its original charm. It focuses on improving gameplay quality, immersion, and performance while keeping the familiar vanilla feel intact. With subtle tweaks, visual enhancements, and convenient features, it offers a smoother, more enjoyable adventure that feels just like Minecraft — only better. Perfect for players who love the base game but want a more polished and refined experience.
